sloka: त्यज तद्वानरानीकं प्राकृतैः किं करिष्यसि।सह स्वैकनिपातं मे पर्वतस्यास्य राक्षस ।। ६.६७.५७ ।।
transliteration: tyaja tadvānarānīkaṁ prākṛtaiḥ kiṁ kariṣyasi।saha svaikanipātaṁ me parvatasyāsya rākṣasa ।। 6.67.57 ।।

translations.english: Sugriva spoke these words seeing Kumbhakarna who stood smeared with the blood of Vanaras and eating monkeys.
